messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: autoscaler eu-west-1-pool-a reporting repeated heartbeat timeouts (5m), free_gpus=0, queue_depth=320 -> severity: high
alice_sre: Got the page, grabbing bridge. Assigning initial triage. Oncall: @frank_oncall, can you confirm any ongoing remediation?
frank_oncall: Joining now, on call. I see high queue growth and sustained token backlog. Autoscaler logs show repeated "scale request rejected: scale_limit_reached" from provider.
bob_runtime: Reproducing metrics — request rate up ~3x for the last 12m, median latency climbing. KV cache hit rates normal. Looks like scale decisions are being sent but not honored.
carol_infra: Provider responded with 403 quota errors for new instances: "project quota vCPU limit reached". No new capacity provisioned.
dave_support: Any customer-facing impact yet? Which tenants are seeing errors/timeouts?
erin_cs: Notified top 3 paying tenants on watch. Support tickets starting to come in — some requests are returning 429 / request queued too long. I have a customer list and recent examples.
alice_sre: Triage notes: two failure modes — (1) autoscaler attempts blocked by provider quota, (2) local queue growth causing throttling. Short-term mitigations: shed non-critical workloads, enable cross-pool routing to eu-west-1-pool-b, and reduce concurrency on heavy tenants.
frank_oncall: Executing cross-pool routing now: running redirect script to move low-priority traffic. Command: `./tools/route-shift --from eu-west-1-pool-a --to eu-west-1-pool-b --filter priority<=10`
bob_runtime: Suggest switching some requests to smaller model variants to lower GPU pressure: route `gpt-medium` for non-enterprise tenants for next 30m. I can flip feature flag.
carol_infra: I've opened a quota raise with provider (ticket AWS-123456) and escalated to TAM. It may take 40-90 minutes. For immediate relief, I can enable burst nodes from our spare AZ reserve (manual override). Need approval.
alice_sre: Approve manual burst. Please annotate audit with reason. Frank, coordinate with runtime to ensure model mapping lines up.
frank_oncall: Manual burst enabled + some queued jobs evicted (low-priority). Queue depth dropping from 320 -> 90 in last 7m. We'll keep throttles in place for heavy tenants.
dave_support: I'm posting customer comms draft: short note that we're experiencing capacity degradation in eu-west, temporary mitigation in progress, ETA unknown. Erin, ready to send once we confirm impact windows.
erin_cs: Sending to affected customers now with a note about temporary degraded throughput.
bob_runtime: Patching feature-flag: smaller-model fallback enabled. Will monitor quality alerts.
carol_infra: Provider confirmed quota increase request acknowledged; ETA ~45m. Burst nodes are a stop-gap, they will auto-deprovision in ~2h.
alice_sre: Good progress. Ops summary so far: manual burst enabled, cross-pool routing applied, smaller-model fallback turned on, customer comms sent. No data loss; customer-facing throttles and higher latencies observed.
frank_oncall: Observability: added temporary alert to suppress noisy backlog alerts once queue < 50 and sustained < 5m.
dave_support: Customers reporting improved throughput in most cases, still seeing occasional 429s for some spikey tenants.
eralert_check: (bot) queue_depth eu-west-1-pool-a = 42, autoscaler_health = degraded, provider_quota_status = pending
alice_sre: Next actions — (1) follow up on provider quota and confirm scale limits (owner: carol_infra), (2) add runbook step for manual burst + audit entries (owner: alice_sre), (3) postmortem + RCA doc (owner: frank_oncall).
frank_oncall: Posting a quick timeline to the incident channel and will schedule 1-hour postmortem tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Action items assigned in GH ticket infra/incident-3849876543.
carol_infra: Follow-up: provider increased quota by 50% at 3849876680, new scale requests now succeeding. Confirming with autoscaler.
bob_runtime: Autoscaler accepted new nodes and scheduling is back to normal. Queue depth steady ~18. Turning off smaller-model fallback after 15m of stability.
erin_cs: Final customer update sent: mitigation applied, working with provider for permanent capacity; will share postmortem when ready.
alice_sre: Closing on-call triage. We'll keep monitoring for 2h, then transition to retrospective. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
frank_oncall: Leaving bridge, handing to oncall follow-up. Postmortem owners — please ensure mitigations and alert tuning steps are tracked.
